answer: One concrete defense is on-chain biometric commitment. Each human stores a one-way hash of a unique biometric template; an agent must later prove in zero knowledge that its template matches the committed hash without revealing it. A fraudster may plant a whole vine of cloned agents, but any two mapping to the same biometric hash are exposed and slashed. Just as no two people compose the same sonnet, no two genuine humans share a template, so a dune of fake identities demands one real biometric per clone, turning free sybil cloning into a costly per-human expense.
